name: Balanced
description: Default day-to-day hardware resource policy: upstream-default CPU energy preference, ZRAM sized to this host's RAM tier if not already configured, no forced I/O scheduler changes without evidence, power-profiles-daemon mapped to its own 'balanced' profile. Describes resource policy only — no packages are installed and no sysfs/config write happens in S2. See docs/hardware/architecture.md.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2; serein hardware plan is read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
